items.wordHook: 早(early) + 安(peaceful) → an early, peaceful greeting for the morning, meaning 'good morning'.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 這是我媽媽做的包子，你吃吃看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ māma zuò de bāozi, nǐ chī chī kàn.
examples.english: These are baozi made by my mother, try eating them.

examples.chinese: 我買了三個麵包，吃了兩個了，最後一個明天再吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān gè miànbāo, chī le liǎng gè le, zuìhòu yī gè míngtiān zài chī.
examples.english: I bought three breads, I have eaten two, I will eat the last one tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 那家有名的麵包店賣很多種麵包，都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǒumíng de miànbāo diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng miànbāo, dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: That famous bakery sells many kinds of bread; all are delicious.

examples.chinese: 明天我有空，我想去買皮包。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yǒu kòng, wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi píbāo.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have free time; I want to go buy a wallet.

examples.chinese: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Where is my wallet?

examples.chinese: 李小姐的錢包是紅色的。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de qiánbāo shì hóngsè de.
examples.english: Miss Li’s purse is red.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
examples.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
examples.english: In the living room, there is a wallet on the table. Is that yours?

examples.chinese: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的錢包不在客廳裡。
examples.pinyin: Nà bú shì wǒ de, shì gēge de. Wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài kètīng lǐ.
examples.english: It is not mine. It is my elder brother’s. Mine is not in the living room.

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
examples.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Ah! There it is! The wallet is under my book.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 有個騙子吃完了麵，假裝忘記帶錢包，騙老闆要回家拿錢，一離開就沒回來了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu ge piànzi chī wán le miàn, jiǎzhuāng wàngjì dài qiánbāo, piàn lǎobǎn yào huí jiā ná qián, yī líkāi jiù méi huílái le.
examples.english: A cheater finished eating noodles and pretended to have forgotten his wallet; he tricked the owner into letting him go home to get money, and as soon as he left, he never came back.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 按照華人的習俗，紅包裡面的錢不可以是四百、四千等等。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Huárén de xísú, hóngbāo lǐmiàn de qián bù kěyǐ shì sìbǎi, sìqiān děngděng.
examples.english: According to Chinese customs, the money inside a red envelope cannot be 400, 4000, etc.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

items.wordHook: a 勹(wrap) rests gently around a sleeping 巳(curl) → 包(wrap).

examples.chinese: 李小姐趁出國時，在機場買了一瓶有名的香水。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě chèn chūguó shí, zài jīchǎng mǎi le yī píng yǒumíng de xiāngshuǐ.
examples.english: Ms. Li, while taking advantage of going abroad, bought a bottle of famous perfume at the airport.

examples.chinese: 我想趁著暑假去旅行，你有什麼建議嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chènzhe shǔjià qù lǚxíng, nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì ma?
examples.english: I want to take advantage of the summer vacation to travel; do you have any suggestions?

examples.chinese: 時間很寶貴，我們應該要趁著年輕多讀書、多學習。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn bǎoguì, wǒmen yīnggāi yào chènzhe niánqīng duō dúshū, duō xuéxí.
examples.english: Time is precious; we should take advantage of our youth to read more and learn more.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 他剛去超市買了一把刷子，想趁週末時好好把浴室刷乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng qù chāoshì mǎi le yī bǎ shuāzi, xiǎng chèn zhōumò shí hǎohǎo bǎ yùshì shuā gānjìng.
examples.english: He just went to the supermarket and bought a scrub brush; he wants to take advantage of the weekend to scrub the bathroom clean properly.

examples.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

examples.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天跑步三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān pǎobù sānshí fēnzhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
examples.english: The doctor suggests that this patient run for thirty minutes every day; this way, his stamina and spirit will get better and better.

examples.chinese: 病人應該多休息，才能早一點兒恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Bìngrén yīnggāi duō xiūxi, cái néng zǎo yīdiǎnr huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The patient should rest more so that he can recover his health a bit sooner.

examples.chinese: 醫生建議這個病人每天跑步三十分鐘，這樣體力、精神就會越來越好的。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì zhège bìngrén měitiān pǎobù sānshí fēnzhōng, zhèyàng tǐlì, jīngshén jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de.
examples.english: The doctor suggests that this patient run for thirty minutes every day; this way, his stamina and spirit will get better and better.

examples.chinese: 護理師的工作就是幫助醫生處理病人的問題。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī de gōngzuò jiùshì bāngzhù yīshēng chǔlǐ bìngrén de wèntí.
examples.english: A nurse's job is to help doctors deal with patients' problems.

examples.chinese: 看病以前要先掛號，再照號碼進去看醫生。病人得先掛了號才可以看病。
examples.pinyin: Kànbìng yǐqián yào xiān guàhào, zài zhào hàomǎ jìnqù kàn yīshēng. Bìngrén děi xiān guà le hào cái kěyǐ kànbìng.
examples.english: Before seeing a doctor, you must first register, then go in according to your number to see the doctor. Patients must first register before they can see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.english: Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese: 病人受傷的地方如果沒有好好處理，很容易會被感染。
examples.pinyin: Bìngrén shòushāng de dìfāng rúguǒ méiyǒu hǎohǎo chǔlǐ, hěn róngyì huì bèi gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: If the injured area of a patient is not properly treated, it can easily become infected.

examples.chinese: 根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒushù de zhǒnglèi, bìngrén zài dòng shǒushù qián néng chī de shíwù yě bù tài xiāngtóng.
examples.english: Depending on the type of surgery, the food patients can eat before undergoing surgery is also not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge bìngrén bù zhīdào zhòng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú, bùjǐn pífū biàn hēi, yě hūnmí hǎo jǐ tiān le.
examples.english: That patient doesn't know what kind of poison he was poisoned with; not only has his skin turned black, but he has also been in a coma for several days.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

examples.chinese: 這位外科醫師不僅很會開刀，對病人也很有耐心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wàikē yīshī bùjǐn hěn huì kāidāo, duì bìngrén yě hěn yǒu nàixīn.
examples.english: This surgeon is not only very skilled at performing operations, but also very patient with patients.

examples.chinese: 要是病人頭很暈又有發燒症狀時，就必須立刻送醫院檢查。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi bìngrén tóu hěn yūn yòu yǒu fāshāo zhèngzhuàng shí, jiù bìxū lìkè sòng yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
examples.english: If a patient is very dizzy and also has fever symptoms, they must be sent to the hospital for examination immediately.

examples.chinese: 不管大人還是小孩，大多數的人都喜歡流行的東西。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn dàrén háishì xiǎohái, dàduōshù de rén dōu xǐhuān liúxíng de dōngxi.
examples.english: No matter adults or children, most people like trendy things.

examples.chinese: 在春節的前一天，大多數的華人都會回到父母家一起慶祝。
examples.pinyin: Zài Chūnjié de qián yī tiān, dàduōshù de Huárén dōu huì huí dào fùmǔ jiā yīqǐ qìngzhù.
examples.english: On the day before the Spring Festival, most Chinese people return to their parents' home to celebrate together.

examples.chinese: 在中國，大多數南方人吃飯，北方人吃麵和水餃。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, dàduōshù nánfāng rén chī fàn, běifāng rén chī miàn hé shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: In China, most southerners eat rice, while northerners eat noodles and dumplings.

examples.chinese: 在中國，大多數南方人吃飯，北方人吃麵和水餃。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, dàduōshù nánfāng rén chī fàn, běifāng rén chī miàn hé shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: In China, most southerners eat rice, while northerners eat noodles and dumplings.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 對大多數人來說，沒有用的垃圾是廢物，有用的垃圾是資源。
examples.pinyin: Duì dàduōshù rén lái shuō, méiyǒu yòng de lājī shì fèiwù, yǒuyòng de lājī shì zīyuán.
examples.english: For most people, useless garbage is waste, and useful garbage is a resource.

examples.chinese: 大多數的模特兒都是腿長腰細的，穿什麼服裝都好看。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de mótèr dōu shì tuǐ cháng yāo xì de, chuān shénme fúzhuāng dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Most models have long legs and thin waists, so they look good in whatever clothes they wear.

examples.chinese: 大多數投資專家都不敢保證在房屋市場一定能賺錢。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù tóuzī zhuānjiā dōu bù gǎn bǎozhèng zài fángwū shìchǎng yīdìng néng zhuànqián.
examples.english: Most investment experts do not dare to guarantee that you can definitely make money in the housing market.

examples.chinese: 我會煮飯、煮水餃，還會炒米粉呢！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, hái huì chǎo mǐfěn ne!
examples.english: I can cook rice, boil dumplings, and even stir-fry rice noodles!

examples.chinese: 我會煮飯、煮水餃，還會炒米粉呢！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, hái huì chǎo mǐfěn ne!
examples.english: I can cook rice, boil dumplings, and even stir-fry rice noodles!

examples.chinese: 日本在台灣的東北方；台灣在中國的東南方。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn zài Táiwān de dōngběifāng; Táiwān zài Zhōngguó de dōngnánfāng.
examples.english: Japan is to the northeast of Taiwan; Taiwan is to the southeast of China.

examples.chinese: 日本在台灣的東北方；台灣在中國的東南方。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn zài Táiwān de dōngběifāng; Táiwān zài Zhōngguó de dōngnánfāng.
examples.english: Japan is to the northeast of Taiwan; Taiwan is to the southeast of China.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le. Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english: Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard. Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 冰箱裡的牛奶早就過期了，你還不扔掉嗎？
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de niúnǎi zǎo jiù guòqī le, nǐ hái bù rēngdiào ma?
examples.english: The milk in the fridge expired long ago—aren't you going to throw it away yet?

items.wordHook: A 扌(hand) grabs the 乃(nǎi) and flings it far away; that tossing motion is 扔(throw away).

examples.chinese: 那個店員只顧著玩手機，客人來了都不知道。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán zhǐ gùzhe wán shǒujī, kèrén lái le dōu bù zhīdào.
examples.english: That clerk only cared about playing on his phone; he didn't even notice when customers came.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 這家超市賣的商品都是安全的，讓顧客買得安心、吃得安心，用的也安心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì mài de shāngpǐn dōu shì ānquán de, ràng gùkè mǎi de ānxīn, chī de ānxīn, yòng de yě ānxīn.
examples.english: The products sold at this supermarket are all safe, allowing customers to buy with peace of mind, eat with peace of mind, and use with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: 媽媽今天要加班，我得照顧妹妹，不能不早一點兒回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma jīntiān yào jiābān, wǒ děi zhàogù mèimei, bùnéngbù zǎo yīdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom has to work overtime today, and I have to take care of my little sister, so I cannot but go home a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 聽說校長要親自帶學生去醫院照顧病人。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xiàozhǎng yào qīnzì dài xuésheng qù yīyuàn zhàogù bìngrén.
examples.english: I heard that the principal is going to personally lead students to the hospital to care for patients.

examples.chinese: 筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 我週末都去育幼院照顧沒有父母的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò dōu qù yùyòuyuàn zhàogù méiyǒu fùmǔ de háizi.
examples.english: On weekends I go to the orphanage to take care of children without parents.

examples.chinese: 鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
examples.pinyin: Línjū yǒu jíshì děi chūmén chǔlǐ, qǐng wǒ zànshí bāng tā zhàogù háizi.
examples.english: My neighbor had an urgent matter to go out and handle, so she asked me to temporarily help take care of her child.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 從小我父母就去世了，一直是我大哥、大嫂在照顧我的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo wǒ fùmǔ jiù qùshì le, yīzhí shì wǒ dàgē, dàsǎo zài zhàogù wǒ de.
examples.english: My parents passed away when I was little; it has always been my eldest brother and sister-in-law who have been taking care of me.

examples.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
examples.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

examples.chinese: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù wǎngzhàn huì bǎ chángjiàn de gòuwù wèntí jí chǔlǐ fāngshì fàng zài wǎngyè shàng, tígōng gěi gùkè cānkǎo.
examples.english: Shopping websites will put commonly seen shopping problems and how to handle them on their web pages, providing them for customers' reference.

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

examples.chinese: 顧客付了錢，賣家也交了貨，這樣子交易才算完成。
examples.pinyin: Gùkè fù le qián, màijiā yě jiāo le huò, zhèyàngzi jiāoyì cái suàn wánchéng.
examples.english: The customer has paid, and the seller has delivered the goods; only then is the transaction considered complete.

examples.chinese: 想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ càiyuán zhàogù hǎo, píngshí jiù děi duō yòngxīn, kàndào chóngzi jiù děi chǔlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to take good care of the vegetable garden, you must be more attentive in daily life; when you see bugs, you must deal with them.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 在照顧及教育孩子上，父母都具有相同的法律義務。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhàogù jí jiàoyù háizi shàng, fùmǔ dōu jùyǒu xiāngtóng de fǎlǜ yìwù.
examples.english: In caring for and educating children, both parents have the same legal obligation.

examples.chinese: 在處理那位顧客的問題上，餐廳的態度真令我失望。
examples.pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ nà wèi gùkè de wèntí shàng, cāntīng de tàidù zhēn lìng wǒ shīwàng.
examples.english: In handling that customer's problem, the restaurant's attitude really disappointed me.

examples.chinese: 他放下工作回家鄉的理由，是因為家裡的農場無人照顧。
examples.pinyin: Tā fàngxià gōngzuò huí jiāxiāng de lǐyóu, shì yīnwèi jiā lǐ de nóngchǎng wú rén zhàogù.
examples.english: The reason he gave up his job and returned to his hometown is that no one was taking care of the family farm.

examples.chinese: 對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。
examples.pinyin: Duì gùkè lái shuō, pǐnpái dàibiǎo le duì gōngsī fúwù de yìnxiàng yǐjí shāngpǐn de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: For customers, a brand represents the impression of the company's service as well as the quality of the product.

examples.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
examples.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

examples.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
examples.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽退休後，就在家幫忙照顧孫子和孫女。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma tuìxiū hòu, jiù zài jiā bāngmáng zhàogù sūnzi hé sūnnǚ.
examples.english: After my mother retired, she helps take care of her grandson and granddaughter at home.

examples.chinese: 要保持古文物原來的樣子不容易，需要好好照顧。
examples.pinyin: Yào bǎochí gǔ wénwù yuánlái de yàngzi bù róngyì, xūyào hǎohǎo zhàogù.
examples.english: It is not easy to keep ancient cultural artifacts in their original condition; they need to be well taken care of.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

examples.chinese: 如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo lìyòng shíwù cáiliào, jiù néng yǒuxiào de jiǎnshǎo chúyú.
examples.english: If food materials can be used well, kitchen waste can be effectively reduced.

examples.chinese: 在天氣好的夜晚，星光看起來更加浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Zài tiānqì hǎo de yèwǎn, xīngguāng kàn qǐlái gèngjiā làngmàn.
examples.english: On nights with good weather, the starlight looks even more romantic.

examples.chinese: 錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiǎojiě dài de nà fù ěrhuán jiù xiàng xīngguāng yīyàng měilì, tīngshuō nà shì zǔmǔ liú gěi tā de huíyì.
examples.english: That pair of earrings Miss Qian is wearing is as beautiful as starlight; I heard that they are a memory her grandmother left to her.

examples.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
examples.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

examples.chinese: 李博士在國際上相當有名，他的研究總能引發學者討論。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóshì zài guójì shàng xiāngdāng yǒumíng, tā de yánjiū zǒng néng yǐnfā xuézhě tǎolùn.
examples.english: Dr. Li is quite famous internationally; his research always sparks discussions among scholars.

items.wordHook: Classifying every living 人(person) into a single biological 類(category) defines all 人類(mankind).
To 打(attack) a 仗(1to rely upon): 打仗 means fight a war.
A wild 龶(growing plant) that you 毋(do not) dare touch contains deadly 毒(poison).
a 火(fire) grips 堯(Yao) straw and flares → 燒(burn).
A single tiny 禾(grain) drops in just a 少(few) fleeting moments of time → 秒(second).
Viewing 缺(lack) scenery at this designated 點(point): 缺點 means shortcoming, defect, disadvantage.
a 羽(feather) drifts onto 白(white) paper → a quiet hour of 習(study).
A sharp corner ⺈(knife tip) marks the boundary that you 用(use) to gauge an 角(angle).
飛(fly) + 機(machine) → a flying machine, an airplane.
